summary: Rendering #1144 advanced scaffolded Contracts to 7.6.0 and Game to 0.17.0. Packed Game signature formatting split Physics.Config's opening record brace from its Gravity field. The manifest's exact proseat anchor `{ Gravity: Point` therefore failed before the generator could produce its normalized mirror, even though the teaching output could remain byte-identical after Fantomas. Reconcile every affected package's anchored prose against its packed signature text during component-axis bumps; normalized output equality alone cannot establish anchor compatibility. The accepted repair targets the unique `{` line within Physics.Config and preserves the prose before the record. First failed candidate bba3532b30f4921a21f29ff2ca36ae8cc96df712 and diagnostic remain public in https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Rendering/actions/runs/38684895429/job/116257391118. Repaired candidate 8eb45b60bf3606b098fc425d972448eba97459c8 passed the canonical generator (98 files, 21 pinned packages, zero rewritten), Build.Tests (79 passed, 2 skipped), and Package.Tests (533 passed) in https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Rendering/actions/runs/38686598980/job/116262766783; PR #1442 delivered the cited merged source. This finding covers consumer pin/mirror source qualification; it does not establish package publication, installed adoption, or a generally sufficient brace anchor outside that bounded declaration.
title: Component pin bumps must reconcile prose anchors before formatter normalization
